title: Virtue of Giving Milk-Giving Goats
summary: Hadith emphasizes the virtue of gifting milk-giving goats as charity for reward.
translation: The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) enumerated many virtues of giving in charity and as gifts. In a hadith, he mentioned that giving a milk-giving goat as a gift is of high value and status, and whoever gifts it hoping for reward from Allah and believing in His promise, will be admitted to Paradise. The Prophet said there are forty qualities, the best among them is to lend a milk-giving goat for use. Anyone who practices any of these forty qualities seeking reward and believing in Allah's promise will enter Paradise. Various qualities, compiled by scholars, include helping in tasks, repairing sandals, concealing the faults of Muslims, sharing in their happiness, providing space in gatherings, guiding rightly, planting trees, giving good counsel, showing mercy, responding to greetings and sneezes, and removing harmful objects from paths. Particularly, lending a milk-giving goat during necessity to be returned after use is highly rewarded. This emphasizes immediate benefits, like fresh milk, showing the value in gifting such an animal.
